summary: Tests pin the exact tmux contract through LocalRunner's real prefill path: paste-buffer -p asserted verbatim (rejects non-bracketed paste), load-buffer content read back and matched to the wake text (rejects send-keys delivery), send-keys Enter counted exactly once after the paste (rejects 0 or 2 submits), and the sibling timeout/vanished cases prove nothing is pasted before the ESC[?2004h readiness signal appears.
